written.headline: Chinese national Li Ming charged in fraud case linked to Megaspeed
written.summary: Chinese national Li Ming was charged with fraud by Singapore prosecutors in February 2025 for allegedly misleading an American supplier regarding the destination of Nvidia-equipped servers. The case involves a network of companies providing advanced computing capacity to Chinese customers through Singapore-based Megaspeed.

written.headline: UBS projects global AI investment to reach USD 1.4 trillion in 2027
written.summary: Global artificial intelligence investment is projected to rise to USD 1.4 trillion in 2027, up from USD 1 trillion in 2026, according to a report by UBS. Around 80 percent of this spending is expected to come from Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, Microsoft, and SpaceX.
